features.title: Everything you need to stay ahead of expiry
features.description: Simple tools that keep your home fresh, safe and organized.

items.title: Expiry tracking
items.description: Every product and its expiry date in one clear, sorted dashboard.

items.title: Smart reminders
items.description: Get notified before things expire, on the schedule you choose.

items.title: Barcode scanning
items.description: Scan a barcode and the product details are filled in for you.

items.title: Smart recipes
items.description: Turn items that expire soon into meals with recipe ideas and a meal planner.

items.title: Household sharing
items.description: Share one inventory with family or roommates so nothing gets missed.

items.title: Shopping list
items.description: Build a list from what you actually need and run low on.

items.title: Waste insights
items.description: See what you use and what goes to waste, and where you can save.

items.title: Zones & categories
items.description: Organize by fridge, pantry, medicine box and category for quick filtering.
